goal: Prevent premature closure of HTTP keep-alive connections when handling pipelined requests
Avoids dropping queued RPC responses when a closing request follows an earlier request
agreement: Verified test reproduces the bug on master and approves concept (hodlinator)
Concept approval because keep-alive state belongs in the send buffer lock (winterrdog)
Thinks it may not be worth review effort due to being hard to reach pragmatically (winterrdog)
Concept approval without detailed reasons, noting low review priority (pinheadmz)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it fixes dropped RPC responses on pipelined connections with connection-close headers
The bug is confirmed by a deterministic test but bitcoin-cli does not pipeline requests
